verdict.rationale: Wise's own site says users can lock in exactly what the recipient will get for up to 24 hours, protected if the rate drops. That is a fixed-window rate guarantee before the transfer completes. The evidence is a single marketing line from wise.com, not detailed docs specific to Wise Business. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the rate-lock mechanics (conditions, which currencies qualify, how it is exposed via quote/API for business accounts), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
